notes.note: Added the Settled reopen rules to Inbox shelves and conversation resolution: the person's send/steer/queued message clears their own record at the send routes (createSenderReopen), request.opened/failed turn/stop clear every person's record (wireConversationResolutionReopen), engine-opened quiet turns keep it; transcript footer and composer notice copy; settle_conversation and station conversation settle|reopen. Checked against conversation-resolution-reopen.ts, orchestration.ts send routes, SettledConversationNotes.tsx and their tests. The composer/CSS source changes only add the settled footer slot and composer notice; other claims unchanged.

Open / Settled entry now states that the person's next message, a question, a failure or a stop reopens a settled conversation and an engine's quiet reply does not; checked against conversation-resolution-reopen.ts and its tests.

Open and Settled paragraph now says sending, a question, a failure or a stop reopens a settled conversation and that its end shows when it was settled with Reopen; checked against the reopen service, send routes and SettledConversationNotes.tsx with its ConversationBody tests.

Personal conversation resolution now records host-side clearing (person's send/steer/queued message clears their record; request.opened, failed turn, session.stop-settled clear everyone's; engine-opened normal turns keep it) and the tool/CLI callers of the same PUT; checked against conversation-resolution-reopen.ts, orchestration.ts and runtime-routes.ts composition. Other route claims unchanged by this diff.
conversation section adds settle/reopen usage, route, JSON envelope and exit codes; checked against packages/cli/src/commands/conversation.ts, help.ts and conversation-settle-command.test.ts.

Adds settle_conversation to the session tools list and its rules (owner's own record via the person's route, preview refusal, unreadable conversation as not found, only when the person asks); checked against station-control-session-search-tools.ts, station-control-policy.ts and the runtime composition test.
